name: The Tower
upright: Life safety first, then property: layered zones, controlled entry, clean power, steady climate, suppression matched to the fire.
reversed: Exits that lock people in, water on electrical fires, a single power feed: the walls fall on those they were built to shelter.
vision: Lightning forks into three prongs named heat, fuel and air and strikes a tower of humming server racks. The crown topples, but the guards let it fall and catch the two tumbling figures first. Flames lean from the windows; someone hurls a bucket at a sparking fuse box, and the water leaps back as more lightning. Along the walls, empty pipes wait for the smoke bell, fill when it rings, and spray only where a glass bulb bursts in the heat. As the lights die, the front door swings open for the fleeing while the vault bolts itself shut. At the gate, a guard gripped by a stranger whistles a nursery tune, and help comes running.
decode: Guards let the crown fall and catch the figures → life safety is always the first priority: people before data, equipment or the building.
Three-pronged lightning; the bucket's water leaping back → the fire triangle: remove heat, fuel or oxygen. Never use water on class C (electrical) fires.
Empty pipes that fill at the smoke bell and spray where a bulb bursts → pre-action sprinklers: two triggers, the best water choice for computer rooms.
Front door opens, vault bolts shut as the lights die → fail-safe unlocks on power loss to protect people; fail-secure stays locked to protect assets.
The guard's nursery tune → a duress code: an innocent-sounding word or signal that warns others the speaker is under coercion.
facts: Wet pipe is always charged and fastest; dry pipe holds air for freezing spaces; pre-action fills on detection and sprays when a head opens; deluge floods via open heads.
Fault and blackout are momentary and prolonged power loss; sag and brownout, low voltage; spike and surge, high voltage. A UPS bridges short gaps; generators carry long ones.
CPTED designs out crime with natural access control, natural surveillance and territorial reinforcement: low shrubs, good lighting and clear sightlines.
trap: The collective remembers the server room that locked its people in. When human life is weighed against data or equipment, life safety wins every time: doors on escape routes fail safe, never secure.
